about: Files moved here byte for byte from another code tree by tools/move-code-between-trees: each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Only import paths and the listed calls differ.

files.adapted: identityOf is this tool's record-identity.mjs and the compiled build is browse-and-upload-my-files loadChunking's Identity, without the retired restartable wrapper; every assertion is the old one

the module and its data are imported from here; setupPlan (old src/setup-plan.mjs) is held, not run, so its plan-equality checks are left out and the mission words are checked on the named paragraph setupPlan copied.

imports name src/agents.mjs and src/failure.mjs here; the third test, an AgentsError through the held old src/tools.mjs handleMcpMessage, is left out: no running code turns a JS tool's refusal into an MCP result.

the MCP initialize test checks agents.pendingForReader, what handleMcpMessage answered as pending_handoffs, and leaves out its two checks on the held old src/tools.mjs greeting words; starters are read from test/fixtures/saved-instruction-starters.json, the old records/ bytes.
the four effect tests are the old ones over src/agents.mjs and src/failure.mjs here; the fifth, a failed run through src/tool-run-owner.mjs, is left out: no repository keeps a tool run owner.

the computer helper and service descriptors are read from their homes (run-on-a-persons-computer, connect-a-service-and-seal-its-key/records.json); the Connections screen test is left out: no running code exports old src/account-screens.mjs connectionsFacts.
makeAis is read from tools/see-and-limit-what-each-ai-can-reach; the four tests of old src/own-ais-routing.mjs and one limitSync check are left out: no repository keeps that routing.

the programs' tables are read from their tools' running readers, held to the old golden values (two tests fail: those tables changed); tests over records files only kept under from-old-trillion, firstChoiceFor and origin settings are left out, and the oauth records are a file of the golden rows.

the MCP-server harness is replaced by the modules that do each part (step versions, recipe-problems, authoring guidance, workflow-tools' schema); the engine-only run checks are left out: no repository runs the workflow routes.
imports name the store host and table generations in keep-and-wake-ai-sessions-on-this-computer; the physical-carry test is left out: no repository keeps old src/resource-state-carry.mjs.
the first test is the old one with the store host's import path named; the second, over a whole old person store (personStoreOver), is left out: that store went with the Worker.
the four tests of the pure moment parts are the old ones; the fifteen that made arrivals through old src/inbound.mjs and the starting rules (src/automations.mjs) are left out: neither runs anywhere.

the six health tests run makeSourceHealth with the formula engine's filter, not the Workshop tool wrapper; the shipped-sample check (kept tool row) and the four readHealth tests (old automations and inbound run nowhere) are left out.
